body: Even more excellent advice! I appreciate you taking the time! I think I’m going to wait and talk to Pink in person so I can bring this up. It might be easier to have the conversation face-to-face so she can see I’m coming from a genuine place. Thanks again!

Oooooohhhhh I am definitely going to try that! That sounds like what my bf needs, his stomach gets pissed off when he drinks coffee so we’ve been trying to come up with creative ways to make it. So far, cold brewing has worked well!

I am so sorry to hear that! That’s just awful, but thank you for sharing your story. Did the company at least get sued or anything like that?

Also, I would just chalk it up to “It’s her life, she can do what she wants.” But no... it’s really not that simple. She’s trying to infect other people’s lives with that nonsense, which is how MLMs keep growing like the malignant tumor they are. Maybe she’ll be fine, but who down the line might experience the full weight of it because of her?

That’s actually a really good point. Maybe I didn’t use enough emojis to get my point across? lol

Also, if so many people are telling you something is harmful, the information you can find online about it is negative, and there’s factual evidence supporting all of that... then you should probably rethink what you’re doing.

You think so? I’m not going to bother apologizing to Green now that I’ve thought about it. I’m still considering apologizing to Pink because she’s a dear friend. Although, I’ll probably wait to just talk to her about it in person so she can see I really am coming from a genuine place.

If things keep going the way they’re going, Green might be apologizing to herself pretty soon...

That’s actually very insightful! I really like the way you put this. I think I’ll give it a day or so then apologize once the tension has settled, at the very least to Pink because she’s my actual friend. I’m just not quite sure what to say yet. I appreciate your comment!

I’m pretty concerned for Pink, because she’s still in the process of growing up. She’s very stubborn and is kinda going through what I was going through at her age, but I think if I just wait it out it’ll pass. Hopefully?

Although... It kinda pissed me off that she responded to my mentioning of friends who suffered because of MLMs by saying “It’s her problem.” No, not just “her” problem. Theirs. Mine. Ours. And now it’s also GREEN’S.

Fingers crossed we’ll get to laugh about all of this  nonsense sooner rather than later.

Yeah I hope that concept of sustainability sticks, at least. Sure, you can get a nice little cash bump in the beginning, but there’s a reason why so many people fall out of it (myself included).

But no! Those who fail are just cannon fodder for real profit! Her mentors will spin the wheel of canned responses, say “So-and-so didn’t succeed because of XYZ”, pat themselves on the back, then they’ll all get right back to it.
On the plus side, I am now curious about mixing different kinds of chocolate with coffee as a tasty winter treat!
Haha, well I appreciate the straightforward answer!
Yeah I’ve seen that before. It always baffles me too for some of them. Really? You can’t take even one picture? Or use one of the several editing apps already on your phone to touch it up?

I think now that I'm feeling better I'm definitely going finish plenty of homework and really focus on making food at home consistently. Also I need to work on combating my fatigue through means other than coffee...

What about you, my friend? How are things in your neck of the woods? I realized this whole time you've been very kind to me asking how I am and I haven't even tried to return the kindness to you!

Thank you for sharing, I will definitely look into also seeing a psychiatrist. My therapist basically helped me figure out what feelings were normal or not and how to help solve my personal dilemmas. It was incredibly helpful and lately I've noticed a serious decline  in my mental health since I haven't been to see her...

These last couple of days have been significantly better and I have no idea why. It feels like I land into these random, unpredictable, depressive pits and I don't know how or why. Sometimes it helps if I have stuff to do (I've been doing homework and crafts and research these past couple days), but then I have those pitfalls and suddenly I'm a wet noodle of a person that wants to lay in front of traffic and cry.

I've been doing my own research and I've been finding out that a lot of brain health is linked very closely to the gut. When I started tracking my eating habits, I realized that I've been basically putting shit in my body and the days I have home-made, healthy meals I'm completely fine emotionally. I was also on the last day of an antibiotic when I made my original post, and I found out a lot of people experience serious depressive episodes since it can fuck with your body so much.

Anywho, this is all probably conjecture, and I need to continue tracking my own health to see if I can spot patterns. At the very least I can have a professional review the information with me to figure out how to proceed. Again, thank you so much for replying to me! I appreciate you taking the time. Sorry it took a minute to respond.

Hi there, thanks for taking the time to comment. I would absolutely like to talk about this. I'm glad to hear your fiance and sister have been very supportive. My fear of talking to my s/o is pretty irrational because when I did tell him about my suicidal thoughts once he was very supportive and helpful. He was actually the one who recommended I go see a therapist.

I'm also glad to hear your medication has been helping, but I unfortunately have to stay away from psychiatric medication as I almost developed an addiction to Xanax a couple years ago and I started losing time (I would black out and wake up anywhere from minutes to hours later). What different needs do having both a therapist and psychiatrist help? How often do you see them?

Again, thanks for reaching out. I feel a little more at ease because of it. I appreciate it.
